title: Special Weather Statement by NWS - NewsBreak
text:
31 minutes ago Check NWS updates here
Effective: 2026-04-22 21:47:00 MDT Expires: 2026-04-22 22:30:00 MDT Urgency: Expected Severity: Moderate Certainty: Observed Instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building. Target Area: Grant; Hooker; Western Cherry At 946 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along a line extending from 12 miles north of Whitman to near Hyannis to 15 miles northwest of Arthur. Movement was east at 35 mph.
HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and half inch hail.
SOURCE...Radar indicated.
IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is possible.
Locations impacted include... Hyannis, Whitman, Carr Lake, Duluth, Cogill Lake, East Cody Lake, Green Lake, Hire, Whitman Road crossing the North Branch of the Middle Loup River, Pratt Lake, Spring Valley Lake, Hecla, and Weir.
This includes the following highways... Highway 2 between mile markers 141 and 179. Highway 61 between mile markers 139 and 177.
